text_diff: +Are you an AI agent? See pricing

-Scrape, Crawl, Map, and Monitor each cost 1 credit per page. Search costs 2 credits per 10 results. Interact costs 2 credits per browser minute. The Firecrawl Research Index paper endpoints are free across every category, including AI/ML and life sciences. Agent is in preview with 5 free daily runs and dynamic pricing. Advanced features (JSON format, etc.) cost additional credits. Check out the credits table on the pricing page for more details.
